name: Thunderbird 24.0
body:
New:
- Signatures can be formatted as HTML for individual identities (#11405)
- Reply prompts users to choose Reply or Reply All when both are applicable (#7055)


Changed:
- Long account names are resized to fit within two lines in the account drawer (#10229)


Fixed:
- Selected compose text was invisible in light theme due to white highlighting (#10974)
- Status bar icons became unreadable when selecting messages in light theme (#11305)
- Recipient expander would not collapse after editing message subject or body (#11375)
- Thunderbird could crash when adding an attachment to a message using the camera (#11296)
- Save All incorrectly saved each attachment using the content of the last file (#10965)
- HTML signature text could disappear after rotating the screen (#11528)
- Editing as new used the default identity instead of the original one for queued mail (#11348)
- QR code scanner failed to open when no accounts were configured (#11276)
- Unsupported QR codes did not display feedback after scanning (#8520)
- With a hardware keyboard the focus could not leave To, Cc or Bcc (#8231)

name: Thunderbird Beta 25.0b1
body:
New:
- New funding appeal helps keep Thunderbird alive! (#11526, #11547, #11580, #11588, #11615, #11620)
- Feature flags can be updated remotely without requiring an app update (#11456)


Fixed:
- Deleted email notifications could reappear or remain in the notification shade (#10936)
- HTML signature text could disappear after rotating the screen (#11528, #11555)
- Some HTML drafts hid attachments while editing and could permanently lose them on save (#954)
- Add to contacts crashed the app when no Contacts app was installed (#11548)
- Sending large PGP-encrypted attachments showed no progress during encryption (#5763)
- Account drawer behaved inconsistently when reselecting an account or tapping its icon (#11461)
- Account drawer controls blocked accounts and folders on small displays (#11476)
- Sort menu indicator (bullet point) was duplicated each time the menu was opened (#11274)

name: Thunderbird 22.0
body:
New:
- Incognito Keyboard privacy setting disables Google keyboard from learning words (#3855)
- Thundermail interim screen when adding an account (#11102)


Changed:
- Selected sort option now shows an indicator in the sort menu (#11184)


Fixed:
- Messages could scroll horizontally when content fit the screen (#11038)
- Thread deletion confirmation incorrectly said only one message would be deleted (#8223)
- Notification actions were difficult to scroll and reorder on small screen (#11191)
- Show Headers collapsed multi-line email headers into a single line (#9452)
- Notification previews displayed HTML entities and markup instead of clean text (#8471, #10256)
- Select Image icon was hard to see in dark theme (#11202)
- Printed message headers always used US date format instead of local format (#11109)
- Splash screen truncated the Thunderbird name on small displays (#11172)
